facts.statement: Recorded terminal reach for this execution: reach_passed = true, with terminal_error_m = 0.0076426 m below the recorded reach_tolerance_m = 0.01 m at the final sampled timestamp.

Recorded holding-window position criterion failed: holding_position_passed = false, and over the six recorded samples of the final holding window (0.30-0.35 s, row_count 6) the error_m maximum is 0.0581381 m, above the recorded settling position_limit_m of 0.01 m (window error_m minimum is 0.0076426 m).

Recorded holding-window speed criterion failed: holding_speed_passed = false, and over the same six recorded final-window samples the speed_m_s range is 0.6351726 to 1.5810153 m/s, above the recorded settling speed_limit_m_s of 0.02 m/s.

Recorded computation readings over their own coverage: mean_update_s = 17.2633 s against control_period_s = 0.01 s across update_count = 35 controller updates, with 35 reported deadline misses for those 35 updates; sampled_settling_passed and joint_reach_holding_passed are both recorded false.

limitations: Read/report-only: no causal attribution, no dominant-cause claim, and no geometry or controller-weight claim is made.

Terminal reach, holding-window position and holding-window speed are reported as distinct recorded criteria over distinct coverage; the holding window is the six recorded samples at 0.30-0.35 s (selected rows only, not whole-trajectory ranges).

Backend motion is a sampled trajectory (record_count 35, 0.01-0.35 s) whose raw gzip bytes are not readable as JSON via evidence.read; it was consulted only through the derived motion/prediction views.
Computation is reported with its own coverage and units; synchronous wall overruns are not described as skipped simulated updates and mean update time is not described as settling error.
Historical warm plans and optimizer iteration traces are not retained (control_snapshots.json), so plan evolution across updates cannot be examined.

A bounded controller-weight experiment under the explicit control grant (only terminal_tip_speed_weight and holding_tip_speed_weight) is a separate improvement decision and is not executed or numerically selected here.
